body:
Writing great marketing copy shouldn't take all week—especially when you're bootstrapped and wearing every hat in your business. Here are the AI tools that'll actually save you hours without making your brand sound like a robot wrote it.

## This Week's Top Picks

**Notion AI**
Write, edit, and brainstorm right inside the workspace where you already live. Best for solopreneurs and small teams who want AI without switching apps. Free + $10/mo.
[Try Notion AI Free →](https://notion.so/?ref=YOURCODE)

**Copy.ai**
Generate marketing copy—emails, social posts, ad headlines—in seconds. Best for e-commerce and service businesses pumping out multiple campaigns weekly. Free + $36/mo.
[Try Copy.ai Free →](https://copy.ai/?ref=YOURCODE)

**Writesonic**
Purpose-built for blogs, landing pages, and ads with templates that actually work. Best for content marketers who need speed without sacrificing structure. Free + $19/mo.
[Try Writesonic Free →](https://writesonic.com/?ref=YOURCODE)

## Quick Tip

Don't just paste AI output into your marketing. Use these tools as a starting point, then inject your voice and specific details—your industry knowledge, customer stories, and unique angle. The AI handles the blank-page problem; you handle making it sound like *you*.

---

**Why these over others?** We skipped the enterprise-priced tools (looking at you, Jasper at $49/mo and Surfer SEO at $89/mo) because most small businesses don't need that firepower yet. Start lean, upgrade when you've got solid ROI.

Ship better content, faster. That's the whole game.

See you next week—

*AI Tools Weekly*
